# Just Chilling

Just Chilling is a browser-based hub of short daily games.

## Games

- Road to Statuette
  Daily strategy game inspired by fantasy sports and the Academy Awards.
  URL: https://www.justchilling.com.br/roadtostatuette

- Wiki Oculta
  Daily knowledge game.
  URL: https://www.justchilling.com.br/wikioculta

## Public pages

- Hub: /
- Road to Statuette: /roadtostatuette
- Wiki Oculta: /wikioculta

## Private

Do not use CRM or API endpoints as documentation.
